elements.description: ISBN numbers in text, validated and marked: hover or focus one for the book's details.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The text to find ISBNs in: plain text, shown as written (line breaks kept)

properties.name: resolve
properties.description: Supplies a book's details for an ISBN-13 – a book, null for none, or a promise; used when no tc-isbn-lookup listener responds

properties.name: hoverDelay
properties.description: How long the pointer rests on a mark before its card opens, ms

properties.name: notFoundText
properties.description: What the card says when there are no details for an ISBN

properties.name: errorText
properties.description: What the card says when the lookup failed

properties.name: isbns
properties.description: The valid ISBNs in `text`, in order

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-isbn-lookup
events.description: A card needs a book's details ({ isbn13, isbn10, signal, respondWith }: IsbnLookupDetail); cancelable – call respondWith() with the book (or a promise), or prevent it without responding for "no details"

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: Copy was pressed on an ISBN ({ text, form }: IsbnCopyDetail); cancelable – prevent it to copy your own way

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A card opened or closed ({ isbn13 }: IsbnOpenChange; null when closed)

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Forgets cached details – one ISBN-13's, or all of them – so the next card asks again

methods.name: openCard
methods.description: Opens the card for the ISBN at `index` in `isbns`, pinned open; focus stays where it is

methods.name: closeCard
methods.description: Closes the open card, if any

functions.name: parseIsbn
functions.description:
Reads an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, written with or without hyphens or spaces and optionally after "ISBN", "ISBN-10" or
"ISBN-13", and gives it in both forms. A 979 ISBN-13 has no ISBN-10. Invalid input gives `{ isbn13: "", valid: false }`.

functions.name: isValidIsbn
functions.description: Whether `input` is a valid ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 (check digit included)

functions.name: findIsbns
functions.description:
Every valid ISBN in `text`, in order: compact or hyphenated (or spaced) as published, with or without an "ISBN"
label (the range covers the number only). Numbers that fail the check digit, 13-digit numbers without the 978 / 979
prefix, and numbers inside longer runs of digits aren't returned.

props.name: onLookup
props.description: Called when a card needs a book's details; call `detail.respondWith(book | promise)` to answer, or use `resolve` instead

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called when Copy is pressed; return false to stop the component writing to the clipboard itself

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the ISBN-13 whose card opened, or null when it closed

changelog: **Text selection:** - `tc-text-annotator`: highlight a passage and comment on it; - `tc-response-selection`: select part of a model reply to reply to it or request an edit; - `tc-selection-translate`: translate the selected text; - `tc-isbn-details`: hover an ISBN for its book details.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
